profile_notes: Primary production model. Qwen3.5-27B base distilled with Claude 4.6 Opus reasoning traces. Reasoning model — outputs thinking tokens before JSON tool calls, causing parse failures in extraction pipelines (OSS LLM claims extraction). Graceful catch in place. 8 experts active / 256 total (MoE). Confirmed active in flamboyant_bell container via settings.json. Training cutoff estimated at 2025-07-01 based on Qwen3.5 release timeline; Claude 4.6 Opus distillation may incorporate more recent signal. No formal eval run yet — profile built from production observation.

temporal._note: Cutoff estimated from Qwen3.5 release timeline. Reasoning distillation may improve staleness awareness vs base model. confabulation_risk=moderate reflects improved reasoning but lack of formal eval data on fabrication behavior.

reasoning_token_leakage.description: Outputs thinking tokens before JSON tool calls. Causes parse failures in extraction pipelines that expect bare JSON.
reasoning_token_leakage.mitigation: Graceful catch in OSS LLM extraction. Strip thinking-token wrapping pending fix.
